theorems.name: Submission.dimred_cdg_im_cone_ball_mass
theorems.statement: ∀ (P j : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) j), IsConeCurrent C → IsIntegerMultiplicity C → (∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → C.massOn (ball 0 ρ) = ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ j) * C.massOn (ball 0 1)) ∧ (∀ θ : ℝ, HasMassDensity C 0 θ ↔ 0 ≤ θ ∧ C.massOn (ball 0 1) = unitBallVolume j * ENNReal.ofReal θ) ∧ ∀ θ : ℝ, 0 < θ → HasMassDensity C 0 θ → (0 : Euclid P) ∈ C.support
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
